source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 20.3.1 with Quick Checks 20.4-20.6 answered, printed pages 62-65.

blocks.text: Electrophile koi bhi ho, electrophilic aromatic substitution ka mechanism (reaction hone ka tareeqa) teen bare steps mein hota hai.

items: Generation of electrophile (electrophile banana): pehle step mein electrophile banta hai. Electrophile koi positive ion ya kisi polar molecule ka positive end (sira) ho sakta hai. Aam taur par electrophile seedha mixture mein nahi dala ja sakta; appropriate (sahi) reagents dal kar yeh mixture ke andar hi (in situ) banaya jata hai.

Electrophilic attack (electrophile par hamla): doosre step mein benzene ke π electrons electrophile par attack karte hain. Is se ring ke ek carbon aur electrophile ke darmiyan sigma bond banta hai. Ab ring mein sirf chaar π electrons reh jate hain aur positive charge paanch carbons par phail jata hai, is liye aromaticity toot jati hai. Naye sigma bond ki wajah se is intermediate (beech mein banne wali cheez) ko sigma complex kehte hain.

Restoration of aromaticity (aromaticity wapas aana): teesre step mein sp³-hybridized carbon wala hydrogen ek counterion/conjugate base hata leta hai aur ring ki aromaticity wapas aa jati hai. Yeh C-H bond ke heterolytic cleavage (aisa tootna jis mein dono electrons ek hi taraf jayein) se hota hai: is bond ke electrons benzene ke π system mein wapas chale jate hain aur ring ki delocalisation restore (wapas) ho jati hai.

blocks.alt: Benzene, jis ki ring se E+ ki taraf curly arrow; phir sigma complex: ring jis ke oopar wale carbon par H aur E, toota circle aur andar +, aur C-H bond se ring ki taraf curly arrow. Doosra arrow, Rapid step, E wala benzene aur H+ deta hai.
blocks.caption: Electrophilic substitution ka aam mechanism (kitab ke PDF page 65 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Curly arrow (mura hua teer) electron pair ki harkat dikhata hai. Pehle ring ke π electrons E⁺ ke saath naya sigma bond banate hain; ring ka positive charge (+) baqi paanch carbons par phail jata hai, is liye circle toota hua dikhaya gaya hai. Phir tez (rapid) step mein C–H bond ke electrons wapas ring mein jate hain, H⁺ nikal jata hai aur aromatic ring wapas ban jati hai.
Arenes ki electrophilic substitution reactions ki misalein neeche hain.
Halogenation of Benzene (benzene par halogen lagana)
Benzene bromine aur chlorine se sirf Lewis acids ki presence (mojoodgi) mein react karta hai, kyun ke Lewis acids halogen se jur kar strong (taqatwar) electrophile banate hain.
Aam Lewis acids yeh hain: aluminium chloride (AlCl₃), iron chloride (FeCl₃) ya iron bromide (FeBr₃).
Yeh benzene ki bromination hai; is ke steps yeh hain:

blocks.alt: Benzene + Br2, arrow ke oopar AlBr3 aur neeche ANHYDROUS (be-aab, paani ke baghair), se bromobenzene + HBr.
blocks.caption: Benzene ki bromination (kitab ke PDF page 65 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.alt: Br-Br, left wale Br par delta+ aur right wale par delta-; curly arrow delta- wale bromine se AlBr3 ki taraf. Arrow ke baad Br+ + [AlBr4]-.
blocks.caption: Br2 aur AlBr3 se electrophile Br+ ka banna (kitab ke PDF page 65 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Electrophile (Br⁺) ban jaye to aage wahi general mechanism chalta hai jo upar parha.

blocks.alt: Benzene, ring se Br+ ki taraf green curly arrow, se sigma complex jis ke aik carbon par Br aur H aur toote circle mein +. [AlBr4]- se us H ki taraf curly arrow, aur C-H bond se ring ki taraf curly arrow. Arrow ke baad bromobenzene + HBr + AlBr3.
blocks.caption: Benzene ki bromination mein Br+ ka attack aur proton ka nikalna (kitab ke PDF page 65-66 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Pehle electrophile ring se jurta hai (addition) aur sigma complex banta hai; phir [AlBr₄]⁻ is se proton (H⁺) hata leta hai. Is se bromobenzene, HBr aur AlBr₃ (catalyst wapas) bante hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke sigma complex se proton “AlCl₄⁻” hatata hai; bromination mein yeh kaam [AlBr₄]⁻ karta hai. Kitab ki tasveer mein Br–Br ke partial charges “σ+ aur σ−” likhe hain; sahi nishan δ+ aur δ− hai. Wapas banne wala catalyst “[AlBr₃)” chhapa hai; sahi AlBr₃ hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle AlBr₃ (Lewis acid) Br–Br ko polar banata hai: AlBr₃ ki taraf wala Br δ− aur doosra δ+ ho jata hai. Bond toot kar Br⁺ (electrophile) aur [AlBr₄]⁻ bante hain. Phir ring Br⁺ par attack (hamla) karti hai, aur [AlBr₄]⁻ sigma complex se H⁺ le kar HBr aur AlBr₃ bana deta hai.
Isi tarah Cl⁺ banane ke liye FeCl₃ Lewis acid activator ke taur par use hota hai. Baqi mechanism bilkul benzene ki bromination jaisa hai.
Quick Check 20.4

blocks.prompt: a) AlCl₃ catalyst ke saath benzene aur chlorine ke reaction ka mechanism likhein.
blocks.explanation: Step 1: Cl₂ + AlCl₃ → Cl⁺ + [AlCl₄]⁻. Step 2: Cl⁺ ring par attack karta hai aur sigma complex banta hai. Step 3: [AlCl₄]⁻ H⁺ hatata hai; chlorobenzene + HCl bante hain aur AlCl₃ wapas mil jata hai.

blocks.text: Nitration of Benzene (benzene par nitro group lagana)
Benzene par nitro group (–NO₂) concentrated HNO₃ aur concentrated H₂SO₄ ke mixture se lagaya jata hai. Mechanism ke steps yeh hain:

blocks.alt: Benzene + HNO3, arrow ke oopar H2SO4, se nitrobenzene + H2O.
blocks.caption: Benzene ki nitration (kitab ke PDF page 66 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

items: Concentrated nitric acid (HNO₃) aur concentrated sulphuric acid (H₂SO₄) ke reaction se electrophile NO₂⁺ ion (nitronium ion) banta hai.
Benzene ring ka ek electron pair NO₂⁺ electrophile ko milta hai aur covalent bond banta hai; is se aromaticity khatam (loss) ho jati hai.
Jis carbon par NO₂ laga, us ka C–H bond toot'ta hai aur electrons wapas benzene ke π system mein chale jate hain; aromaticity wapas aa jati hai.

blocks.text: Mechanism (reaction hone ka tareeqa)

blocks.alt: Teen steps. Electrophile ka banna: H2SO4 + HNO3 aur NO2+ + HSO4- + H2O ke darmiyan equilibrium, NO2+ par electrophile ka label. Electrophile ka attack: benzene ring se NO2+ ki taraf curly arrow, aik carbon par H aur NO2 wala sigma complex; C-H bond se ring ki taraf curly arrow, nitrobenzene + H+. Catalyst ki wapsi (regeneration): HSO4- + H+ se H2SO4, catalyst ka label.
blocks.caption: Benzene ki nitration ka mechanism (kitab ke PDF page 66 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Sulphuric acid nitric acid se strong (taqatwar) acid hai: yeh HNO₃ ko proton deta hai, aur HNO₃ paani kho kar NO₂⁺ (nitronium ion, electrophile) ban jata hai. Ring NO₂⁺ par attack karti hai, phir C–H bond toot kar ring wapas aromatic hoti hai aur H⁺ nikalta hai. Yeh H⁺ HSO₄⁻ se mil kar H₂SO₄ wapas bana deta hai, is liye H₂SO₄ catalyst hai.

Concentrated sulphuric acid catalyst ka kaam karta hai, is liye equations mein nahi likha jata. Zyada temperature par ring mein ek se zyada nitro groups lagne ka chance (imkaan) barh jata hai. 50°C par bhi kuch 1,3-dinitrobenzene ban jata hai.

blocks.alt: Nitrobenzene + HNO3, arrow ke oopar 50 °C, se 1,3-dinitrobenzene + H2O.
blocks.caption: 1,3-dinitrobenzene ka banna (kitab ke PDF page 67 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Quick Check 20.5

blocks.prompt: Dikhayein ke nitration mein sulphuric acid aur nitric acid se electrophile kaise banta hai. In mein kaun acid ka aur kaun base ka kaam karta hai?
blocks.explanation: H₂SO₄ + HNO₃ ⇌ NO₂⁺ + HSO₄⁻ + H₂O. Sulphuric acid proton deta hai, is liye acid hai; nitric acid proton leta hai (phir paani kho kar NO₂⁺ banta hai), is liye yahan base ka kaam karta hai.

blocks.text: Friedel-Crafts Alkylation and Acylation

Friedel-Crafts acylation mein Lewis acid catalyst ki presence (mojoodgi) mein benzene ring par acyl group lagta hai. Acyl group woh alkyl group hai jo carbonyl group se jura ho, R-C=O. Friedel-Crafts alkylation mein benzene ring par alkyl group lagta hai.

blocks.alt: Friedel-Crafts Alkylation: benzene + CH3CH2Cl, arrow ke oopar heat aur neeche AlCl3 catalyst, se ethylbenzene + HCl. Friedel-Crafts Acylation: benzene + CH3CH2COCl, heat aur AlCl3 catalyst, se C(=O)CH2CH3 wali ring + HCl.
blocks.caption: Friedel-Crafts alkylation aur acylation (kitab ke PDF page 67 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: a) Friedel-Crafts Alkylation
Friedel-Crafts alkylation teen steps ke mechanism se hoti hai.

items: Lewis acid catalyst (AlCl₃) alkyl halide se react karta hai aur carbocation (positive carbon wala ion) banta hai, jo electrophile hai.

blocks.alt: (CH3)3C-Cl, Lewis base, Cl par lone pairs, + AlCl3, Lewis acid; Cl ke lone pair se AlCl3 ki taraf curly arrow. Is se Cl(+)-AlCl3(-) jo abhi carbon se jura hai, aur C-Cl bond se Cl ki taraf curly arrow. Products: 3° (tertiary) carbocation (CH3)3C+, electrophile - E+, aur [Cl-AlCl3]-.
blocks.caption: Friedel-Crafts alkylation mein carbocation ka banna (kitab ke PDF page 67 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

items: Aromatic ring ke π electrons carbocation par attack karte hain aur intermediate ke taur par arenium ion banta hai. Carbon-carbon double bond tootne se arene ki aromaticity temporarily (thori der ke liye) khatam ho jati hai.

Intermediate se proton nikalne (deprotonation) par carbon-carbon double bond phir ban jata hai aur aromaticity wapas aa jati hai. Yeh proton HCl (hydrochloric acid) banata hai aur AlCl₃ catalyst wapas mil jata hai.

blocks.alt: Naya carbon-carbon bond: benzene se tertiary carbocation ki taraf curly arrow (electrophile ka addition) se sigma complex ki resonance structure, ring ke carbon par H aur C(CH3)3 aur ring mein +. Proton ka nikalna, aromaticity wapas: [Cl-AlCl3]- se H ki taraf curly arrow, aur C-H bond se ring ki taraf curly arrow; arrow ke neeche -AlCl3, product tert-butylbenzene + HCl.
blocks.caption: Friedel-Crafts alkylation ka mechanism (kitab ke PDF page 68 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: AlCl₃ (Lewis acid) Cl ka lone pair le leta hai, C–Cl bond toot'ta hai aur (CH₃)₃C⁺ carbocation (electrophile) banta hai. Ring is carbocation par attack kar ke naya C–C bond banati hai. 'Resonance structure' sigma complex ke kai structures mein se ek hai: + charge ring ke carbons par ghoomta hai. Aakhir mein [AlCl₄]⁻ H⁺ le kar HCl banata hai aur AlCl₃ wapas mil jata hai.
b) Friedel-Crafts Acylation
Kitab ke mutabiq Friedel-Crafts acylation chaar steps ke mechanism se hoti hai; kitab neeche us ke teen hisse likhti hai.

items: Lewis acid catalyst (AlCl₃) aur acyl halide react karte hain. Ek complex banta hai aur acyl halide ek halide ion kho deta hai; is se acylium ion banta hai.

blocks.alt: R-C(=O)-Cl, Lewis base, Cl par lone pairs, + AlCl3, Lewis acid, se complex R-C(=O)-Cl(+)-AlCl3(-), jis se acylium ion R-C(+)=O aur [Cl-AlCl3]- bante hain.
blocks.caption: Friedel-Crafts acylation mein acylium ion ka banna (kitab ke PDF page 68 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

items: Aromatic ring ke π electrons acylium ion (RCO⁺) par electrophilic attack karte hain.

Intermediate complex se proton nikal jata hai aur ring ki aromaticity wapas aa jati hai. Yeh proton chloride ion se mil kar HCl banata hai aur AlCl₃ catalyst wapas mil jata hai. Is tarah Friedel-Crafts acylation se acyl benzene product milta hai.

blocks.alt: Benzene se R-C(+)=O ke carbon ki taraf curly arrow (O par lone pair, aur C=O bond se O ki taraf curly arrow) se sigma complex ki resonance structure, ring ke aik carbon par H aur C(=O)R aur ring mein +. [Cl-AlCl3]- se H ki taraf curly arrow aur C-H bond se ring ki taraf curly arrow; arrow ke neeche -AlCl3, product aryl ketone, ring par C(=O)R.
blocks.caption: Friedel-Crafts acylation ka mechanism (kitab ke PDF page 68 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Acylation mein electrophile acylium ion R–C⁺=O hai; O ka lone pair is ke + charge ko kuch had tak sambhalta hai. Ring is ke carbon par attack karti hai, sigma complex banta hai, phir [AlCl₄]⁻ H⁺ le kar HCl banata hai aur aromatic ring wapas aati hai. Product aryl ketone hai; maslan R = CH₂CH₃ ho to C₆H₅COCH₂CH₃.
Quick Check 20.6

blocks.prompt: 1. AlBr₃ ki presence (mojoodgi) mein methyl benzene aur bromine ka reaction likhein.
blocks.explanation: Ring ki positions 2 aur 4 par substitution hoti hai (CH₃ ortho-para director): C₆H₅CH₃ + Br₂ → 2-bromomethylbenzene aur 4-bromomethylbenzene (mixture) + HBr.

blocks.prompt: 2. Bromine ki benzene aur phenol ke saath reactivity mein farq batayein: reaction ki type, products aur conditions. (Mechanism nahi chahiye.)
blocks.explanation: Dono electrophilic substitution hain. Benzene ko liquid bromine aur Lewis acid catalyst (FeBr₃ ya AlBr₃) chahiye; bromobenzene + HBr bante hain. Phenol ka OH group ring ko bohat active karta hai, is liye bromine water room temperature par baghair catalyst react karta hai aur 2,4,6-tribromophenol ka safed precipitate + 3HBr banta hai.

rows: liquid (pure) Br₂ + Lewis acid catalyst (FeBr₃ ya AlBr₃)
bromine water, room temperature, catalyst nahi
ring par ek Br: bromobenzene + HBr
-OH ring ko bohat active karta hai

blocks.prompt: 3. Bromine ki benzene aur ethyl benzene ke saath reactivity mein farq batayein: reaction ki type, products aur conditions. (Mechanism nahi chahiye.)
blocks.explanation: Andhere mein Lewis acid catalyst ke saath dono ring par substitution karte hain: benzene bromobenzene deta hai; ethyl benzene tezi se react karta hai (ethyl group ring ko active karta hai) aur 2- aur 4-bromoethylbenzene deta hai. UV roshni mein baghair catalyst ethyl benzene ki side chain par free radical substitution hoti hai, zyada tar ring ke saath wale CH₂ par, aur (1-bromoethyl)benzene banta hai; benzene ka ring aise substitute nahi hota.

rows: sirf ring par electrophilic substitution (Lewis acid catalyst, andhera)
catalyst ke saath ring par substitution, benzene se tez (ethyl group ring ko activate karta hai)
UV roshni mein ring par substitution nahi
UV roshni mein, catalyst ke baghair, side chain par free radical substitution: (1-bromoethyl)benzene

blocks.prompt: 4. Friedel-Crafts reaction se 1,1-dimethylethylbenzene aur methyl benzene mein se kaun aasani se banta hai? Carbocation ki stability se samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: 1,1-dimethylethylbenzene (tert-butylbenzene). Is ka electrophile tertiary carbocation (CH₃)₃C⁺ hai, jo teen alkyl groups ki wajah se stable hai; methyl benzene ke liye bohat unstable methyl cation CH₃⁺ chahiye.

blocks.text: Summary (khulasa)

items: Teen steps: electrophile banna, ring ka attack (sigma complex), H⁺ nikalna aur aromaticity wapas.
Halogenation: Br₂/AlBr₃ (ya Cl₂/FeCl₃); nitration: HNO₃ + H₂SO₄ se NO₂⁺; Friedel-Crafts: AlCl₃ se R⁺ ya RCO⁺.
Lewis acid ya H₂SO₄ aakhir mein wapas mil jata hai: yeh catalyst hai.
